subject: Evaluation scope & hosting pathway — Redwood options and next steps
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@finbot.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Eval scope & hosting pathway

Hi Olivia —

Great conversation earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call highlights
- FinBot product: real-time summarization for trader notes, strict latency and retention needs.
- Primary concerns: predictable latency under burst, data residency, and KMS integration.
- Stakeholders you mentioned: Rajiv (CTO), Maya (Compliance).

Redwood hosting options we discussed (short):
1) Hosted API — fastest to ship, lower ops burden, multi-tenant. Good for early validation.
2) Dedicated capacity — reserved GPU pools, predictable throughput, better isolation (recommended if you need consistent P95 latency).
3) Private (VPC/on-prem) — customer-managed network, full isolation and KMS/HSM options (longer lead time).

Proposed PoC structure (4-week scoped evaluation):
- Week 0: SOW and access (test keys, sample dataset ingest)
- Weeks 1–2: Integration + baseline perf runs (we’ll exercise typical traffic shapes)
- Week 3: Optimizations (batching, KV cache, quantization profiles)
- Week 4: Final validation and handoff (metrics, runbook, recommended config)

Initial success criteria (for proposal) — please confirm or edit:
- P95 inference latency < 200ms on dedicated pool for 512-token requests
- End-to-end request success rate > 99.5% during business hours
- Cost envelope target: under $X per 1M tokens (we’ll provide options)
- Security: SOC2 evidence + KMS integration validated in demo environment

Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf, eval-checklist.xlsx, PoC-runbook.md (stubs attached).

Next steps
- Please confirm preferred hosting mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and primary decision owners.
- If Dedicated or Private: can we get preliminary network/firewall contact and a basic RFI?
- Proposed technical deep-dive: Tue 24 Nov, 30 min. Thoughts?

Thanks — I’ll prep a concise SOW and pricing options once you confirm the path.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@finbot.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv@finbot.ai>, Maya Singh <m.singh@finbot.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Eval scope & hosting pathway

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the summary — that’s helpful. A few clarifications from our side after I chatted with Rajiv this morning:
- We’re leaning toward Dedicated capacity for the PoC. Predictable throughput and isolation are important for our trading workloads.
- Compliance/KMS: we need to validate that Redwood can integrate with our AWS KMS and provide audit logs. SOC2 attestation is a must.
- Data residency: traffic must remain in us-east-1. Is that supported for Dedicated pools?

Stakeholders for the PoC
- Rajiv Singh — CTO (technical sign-off)
- Maya Singh — Head of Compliance (security & data residency)
- Olivia Barnes — Product lead (integration owner)

I’ve attached a short RFI and our network requirements (Security-RFI.pdf, Network-requirements.xlsx).

We can do the technical deep-dive on Tue 24 Nov at 10:30am ET. Primary ask for that call: a network/KMS checklist and initial Dedicated sizing guidance.

Also — can you provide a short SOW and a pricing band for 4-week Dedicated PoC (including options for burst capacity)? That will help our procurement team.

Thanks,
Olivia
Head of Product | FinBot.ai
olivia@finbot.ai | +1 (212) 555-0199
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@finbot.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv@finbot.ai>, Maya Singh <m.singh@finbot.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Eval scope & hosting pathway

Perfect — thanks for the direction. Confirming Tue 24 Nov 10:30am ET for the deep-dive (I’ll send calendar invite).

What we’ll bring to the deep-dive
- Redwood: Rishi will walk through Dedicated sizing and network/KMS flows; I’ll present the PoC success metrics and options; Marissa will review SOW scope and commercial bands.
- FinBot: Rajiv to outline traffic shapes; Maya to review logging/KMS expectations.

Updated success criteria (working draft to validate on call)
- Performance: P95 inference latency < 200ms at target load (bursts up to X RPS)
- Reliability: 99.5% success rate across 2-week sustained run at target load
- Security: KMS integration validated, audit/log delivery to your SIEM within 24 hours
- Business: integration time < 2 weeks for end-to-end demo and ability to go to production with Dedicated within 8 weeks if agreed

Deliverables we’ll provide before Tue
- Short SOW + pricing bands (SOW-draft.pdf)
- Dedicated sizing options and estimated lead time
- PoC runbook (PoC-runbook.md) and eval checklist (eval-checklist.xlsx)

Action items for us (internal): Marissa to finalize SOW, Rishi to prepare network/KMS checklist, Vanessa to prepare pricing bands including burst options.

I’ll attach the PoC-runbook and a one-page Dedicated overview to the invite.

Best,
Alex

Subject: Internal: FinBot Dedicated PoC — SOW/pricing prep

Team — quick internal note following Olivia’s confirmation.

Context: FinBot is committing to a 4-week Dedicated PoC. They require SOC2 evidence, KMS integration (AWS KMS), us-east-1 residency, and predictable P95 latency. Procurement asked for a short SOW and pricing band for approval.

Please own the following by EOD Mon:
- Marissa: SOW-draft.pdf — scope (4-week PoC), acceptance criteria, deliverables, cancellation terms, basic invoice terms.
- Rishi: Network/KMS checklist + Dedicated sizing options (include burst capacity option and estimated pool sizes).
- Vanessa: Commercial bands and an optional Private deployment estimate (high-level) in case they ask to switch later.

I’ll coordinate the Tue 24 deep-dive calendar and include the PoC runbook and eval checklist. We should be ready with the DocuSign-ready SOW link for Rajiv after the call.

Thanks —
Alex
